Patrat

Normal

Unova · Generation 5

Patrat is a Normal-type Scout Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 11.6 kg. It evolves into Watchog. Its highest base stat is Attack (55), with a base stat total of 255.
